subject: POC kickoff & weekly check-ins for Acme Industries
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acme-industries.com>, Priya Kothari <priya.k@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (success criteria, timeline, owners)

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Really excited about the opportunity to run a short POC with Acme to validate Redwood's inference runtime on your document processing workload. Quick recap and proposed next steps below so we're all aligned.

Success criteria (what we'll measure):
- Latency: 95th percentile token-response time <= 400ms for your 512-token median requests.
- Throughput: sustain 20 concurrent sessions for 2x peak batch windows.
- Cost: per-token inference cost improvement >= 25% vs your current baseline.
- Quality: end-to-end extraction F1 >= 0.92 on the sample set you shared.

Evaluation plan:
- Week 0 (setup): access, infra config, and sample data upload.
- Weeks 1-2 (tuning & runs): run baseline, enable batching/caching, try quantized model variant.
- Week 3 (readout): final runs, metrics review, and recommendations.

Ownership:
- Redwood: Marissa (program lead) + Rafael (tech lead) for infra/config/tuning.
- Acme: Jordan (product) + Priya (engineering) for data access, test cases, and validation.

Kickoff options: next Tuesday 2026-06-23 at 10:00am PT or Wednesday 2026-06-24 at 9:00am PT. Proposed weekly check-ins: 30 minutes every Tuesday for the duration of the POC.

I attached a v1 POC plan and an evaluation criteria sheet — please review and share any updates. If this looks good I'll schedule the kickoff and send calendar invites.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: POC_plan_acme_v1.pdf, evaluation_criteria_sheet.xlsx

From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acme-industries.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Kothari <priya.k@acme-industries.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (success criteria, timeline, owners)

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan. Priya and I talked it through and this matches what we discussed. A couple of notes from our side:
- The F1 threshold is OK but can we add a secondary quality check for extraction recall on invoices specifically? That's our top priority.
- We need the first week to include a short profile run against our redacted dataset (we can share redaction script).

Kickoff: Wednesday 2026-06-24 at 9:00am PT works best for us.

I'll send the sample dataset and redaction script by EOD tomorrow. Also looping in Priya for engineering availability on the first two weeks.

Best,
Jordan
Product Manager, Acme Industries
jordan.mills@acme-industries.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-06-20T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (success criteria, timeline, owners)

Perfect — thanks Jordan. We'll add the invoice recall check as a secondary metric (capture as part of the evaluation sheet). Rafael / Neha: Rafael can you confirm the infra checklist for Wednesday's kickoff and whether we need any temporary firewall rules for Acme's VPC peering?

Rafael, also please prepare one baseline run and one quantized-run recipe so we can compare latency/cost quickly. I'll put a calendar invite for 2026-06-24 09:00 PT and a recurring 30-minute weekly check-in for Tuesdays after that (first check-in Tue 2026-06-30).

Jordan / Priya: once you share the dataset link we'll validate access and schedule the profile run.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole

Marissa / team —

Quick infra notes:
- We'll provision a dedicated trial pool (1x A100-equivalent) for the first two weeks; tuning can run on a smaller instance if needed.
- For the profile run, we only need an S3 link and IAM role with read access OR a temporary SFTP endpoint. No VPC peering required for the first phase unless Acme wants private networking.
- I'll upload two run recipes to the shared Drive: baseline_run.sh and quantized_run.sh. Those will include the exact model variants and kernel flags we'll use.

I'll be available on the kickoff and the Tuesday check-ins.

Rafael Mendes
